facts.business: Adeshwar Meditex Limited is an integrated healthcare products company engaged in manufacturing, processing, export, distribution, and supply of medical consumables and healthcare solutions including sterile surgical wound dressings, advanced wound care products, medical bandages, gauzes, swabs, adhesive products, surgical disposables, infection prevention products, protective healthcare products, and first aid kits.
